title: Ahab
summary: King of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Omri. Jones dates his accession.
description: King of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Omri. Jones dates his accession. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Ussher–Jones). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: 3086 918 Ahab becomes king over Israel.
